result_text:
The Duplication report now has a "Most Frequent Duplicates" section right after "Longest Duplicates". It compiles, but I didn't run any tests or generate a report to look at it.

`addMostFrequentDuplicatesList` was already in the report generator but nothing called it. The "Code" links were also missing their files. The section already gave the "The list of N most frequently found duplicates." description and left itself out when the list is empty. I changed two files:

- **`DuplicationReportGenerator.java`:** the report now calls `addMostFrequentDuplicatesList(report)` after the longest-duplicates step.
- **`DataExporter.java`:** with `saveCodeFragments` on, the fragments are saved to `fragments/most_frequent_duplicates/most_frequent_duplicates_<n>.<ext>`.
- **`DataExporter.java`:** I also added the most frequent duplicates' source files to the referenced-files set, as is done for the longest duplicates. You didn't ask for that.
